<?php

$s = trim(fgets(STDIN));
$qq = "QAQ";
$len = strlen($s);
$arr = array_fill(0, $len + 1, array_fill(0, 4, -1));

function Q($m, $n) {
    global $s, $qq, $arr;
    
    if ($arr[$n][$m] != -1) {
        return $arr[$n][$m];
    }
    if ($m == 0) {
        return 1;
    }
    if ($n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    
    $i = 0;
    $j = 0;
    
    if ($qq[$m - 1] == $s[$n - 1]) {
        $i = Q($m - 1, $n - 1);
    }
    
    $j = Q($m, $n - 1);
    
    $arr[$n][$m] = $i + $j;
    return $i + $j;
}

echo Q(3, $len) . "\n";

?>

5.  The logic: `Q(m, n)` where m is index in "QAQ" (1..3), n is index in input string (1..len).
    Base cases: m==0 -> 1 (empty subsequence matches once). n==0 -> 0 (non-empty subseq in empty string).
    Recurrence: if chars match, sum of `Q(m-1, n-1)` and `Q(m, n-1)`. Else `Q(m, n-1)`.
